name: sleepy-agent
description: Durable same-task continuation through Codex Desktop's own App Server

interface.shortDescription: Sleep through long waits, then continue.
interface.longDescription: Runs a read-only background checker and lets Codex Desktop's own App Server deliver one verified continue message to the original task without UI automation or a second App Server.
defaultPrompt: Register a durable wait for this task when work is blocked only on waiting.
